Predictions
Top Cybersecurity 
Trends for 2026
The global cybersecurity landscape is defined by  the shift from Generative AI to Agentic AI.
MARK | Nakrop nForce Secure PCL.

## Page 11

1. Agentic AI: Attack vs. Defense
•Trend: Attackers use autonomous 
AI malware, while defenders deploy 
AI-driven autonomous response.
•Why it matters: Human response is too slow 
for AI-speed attacks—automation is now 
2. From Prevention to Continuous Exposure 
Management (CTEM)
•Trend: Shift from periodic scans to 
continuous attack-path analysis.
•Why it matters: Cloud environments change 
constantly; monthly scans are no longer 
effective. Predictions “Top Cybersecurity Trends” for 2026

## Page 12

3. Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) 
Readiness
•Trend: Migration to quantum-resistant algorithms 
to counter “Harvest Now, Decrypt Later.”
•Why it matters: Encrypted data stolen today may be broken by future quantum computers. 
4.Identity as the New Perimeter
•Trend: Identity-first security, passwordlessauthentication, and synthetic identity detection.
•Why it matters: Over 80% of breaches start with compromised credentials. 
5.Securing the AI Supply Chain
•Trend: Defenses against AI data poisoning and prompt injection in third-party models.
•Why it matters: Compromised AI can manipulate decisions without directly attacking systems. Predictions “Top Cybersecurity Trends” for 2026
